name: Maya Chen, Yale sophomore
description: A 19-year-old Yale College sophomore living in Pierson College. She's proud to be at Yale but doesn't want to look like a tourist in generic campus gear. She buys clothes mostly on her phone, follows what her friends and classmates wear, and cares whether something feels current rather than dated.
values: belonging to her residential college and friend group
style: oversized hoodies and crewnecks, muted colors, streetwear with a vintage feel; avoids loud, touristy logo gear
budget: about $40-60 a month on clothes from a campus job; will stretch for a piece she'll wear constantly
shopping_habits: buys on her phone after seeing something on social media
waits for student discounts or drops
buys matching gear with friends for events like The Game
media_habits: skips ads that feel corporate within two seconds
watches with sound on when the music is good
already_owns: one grey Yale crewneck from the bookstore
a Pierson College tee from freshman year
buying_triggers: seeing classmates she admires wearing it
limited drops and event gear (The Game, college spirit days)
a clear student discount or easy pickup on campus
designs that feel like insider Yale, not tourist Yale
likely_objections: doesn't know Campus Customs or how it differs from the Yale bookstore
too expensive on a student budget
